articles.title: Admission Process Overview
articles.body:
The admission process at the academy is designed to be simple and transparent.

1. **Browse courses** — Explore our catalog to find the right course for your career goals.
2. **Get a fee quote** — Request a fee quote for any course + batch combination. Quotes are valid for 7 days.
3. **Request a callback** — A counsellor will call you to discuss course details, prerequisites, and payment options.
4. **Enroll** — After the callback, you can enroll by confirming your lead. A seat will be reserved in the upcoming batch.

No payment is required until enrollment confirmation.

articles.title: Course Prerequisites
articles.body:
Each course has different prerequisites:

- **Agentic AI Engineering** (12 weeks, advanced): Strong Python programming, basic ML concepts, familiarity with APIs.
- **MLOps Engineering** (8 weeks, advanced): Production Python, CI/CD basics, Docker fundamentals.
- **AIOps & MLOps** (10 weeks, advanced): Python, basic DevOps, understanding of ML lifecycle.
- **Generative AI Foundations** (6 weeks, intermediate): Basic Python, curiosity about AI/ML.

Not sure which course fits? Request a callback and a counsellor will help you decide.

articles.title: Fee Structure & Payment Options
articles.body:
Fee quotes are generated per course + batch combination and include:
- **Tuition fee** — the base course fee.
- **Early-bird discount** — available for registrations made 30+ days before batch start.
- **Total** — the final payable amount.

Payment options:
- Full upfront payment (no extra charge).
- EMI plans available through partner financial institutions (3, 6, or 12 months).
- Need-based scholarships for deserving candidates — ask your counsellor during the callback.

All quotes are valid for 7 days from generation.

articles.title: Batch Schedule & Modes
articles.body:
Batches are offered in three modes:

- **Online** — Live instructor-led sessions via Zoom/Meet. Recordings available for 30 days.
- **In-person** — On-campus at our Bangalore center. Limited seats (typically 20-25).
- **Hybrid** — Attend online or in-person. Best of both worlds.

Batches typically run for 6-12 weeks depending on the course. New batches start every 4-6 weeks. Use the 'batches_find_upcoming' tool to see the next available batch for any course.

articles.title: Callback & Support
articles.body:
Need to talk to someone? You can request a callback from our admissions team.

- **How to request**: Simply ask the assistant 'I'd like a callback' or use the callback request flow.
- **What happens**: A lead is created with your contact info. A counsellor is assigned and will call you within 24-48 hours.
- **Working hours**: Mon-Sat, 10 AM - 7 PM IST.
- **Support email**: admissions@academy.example

You'll receive a callback reference number once the callback is scheduled.

articles.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
articles.body:
Our refund policy is student-friendly:

- **Before batch start**: Full refund minus a 5% processing fee.
- **Within first 3 sessions**: 70% refund.
- **After 3 sessions**: No refund, but you can defer to a future batch at no extra cost.

To request a refund, contact your assigned counsellor or email admissions@academy.example with your enrollment reference number.

articles.title: Career Outcomes & Placement Support
articles.body:
The academy provides comprehensive placement support:

- **Resume building** — 1:1 sessions with career coaches.
- **Mock interviews** — Technical + behavioral interview practice.
- **Job portal access** — Exclusive job board with 200+ hiring partners.
- **Placement guarantee** — For Agentic AI Engineering and MLOps Engineering courses (terms apply).
- **Alumni network** — Lifetime access to our alumni Slack community.

Average salary hike for our graduates: 45% (based on 2024-2025 data).

articles.title: Technical Requirements
articles.body:
To attend our courses you'll need:

**Hardware:**
- A laptop with 8GB+ RAM (16GB recommended for advanced courses).
- Stable internet connection (5+ Mbps for live sessions).
- Webcam + microphone for interactive sessions.

**Software:**
- Python 3.10+ (we'll help you set this up).
- A code editor (VS Code recommended).
- Docker (for MLOps/AIOps courses).

Don't worry if you're not set up yet — the first session includes a guided environment setup.
